implement.summary:
DRAFT FOR PROFESSIONAL REVIEW — NOT FINANCIAL, TAX, OR INVESTMENT ADVICE

1. Scope, Basis, and Stated Assumptions
- Currency: Pounds Sterling (GBP / £) for all figures.
- Period: Three consecutive 12-month loan years (Year 1, Year 2, Year 3) measured from the loan drawdown date.
- Basis: Compound interest accrued and capitalised once annually on each loan anniversary; no principal repayments, interest payments, arrangement fees, charges, or penalties occur during the 3-year term.
- Inputs from Request: Initial principal = £200,000.00 (GBP, at drawdown / start of Year 1); annual interest rate = 6.00% per annum; term = 3 years; compounding frequency = 1 time per year; repayments = £0.00.
- Assumptions (where not specified in request): The 6.00% rate is fixed across all 3 years; compounding occurs on exact annual anniversaries (3 compounding events total, no partial-year day-count adjustment); figures are rounded to 2 decimal places (nearest penny) at each year-end; tax effects are outside scope.

2. Year-by-Year Loan Balance Schedule (GBP, Loan Anniversary Basis)

Year 1 (Months 1–12, GBP, Annual Compounding Basis):
- Opening Principal / Balance: £200,000.00 (Source: Request input — initial loan principal)
- Repayments During Year 1: £0.00 (Source: Request input — nothing repaid)
- Interest Accrued (Year 1): £200,000.00 × 6.00% (0.06) = £12,000.00 (Source: Opening balance × fixed annual rate)
- Closing Balance (End of Year 1): £200,000.00 + £12,000.00 = £212,000.00 (Source: Opening balance + capitalised Year 1 interest)

Year 2 (Months 13–24, GBP, Annual Compounding Basis):
- Opening Balance: £212,000.00 (Source: Year 1 Closing Balance)
- Repayments During Year 2: £0.00 (Source: Request input — nothing repaid)
- Interest Accrued (Year 2): £212,000.00 × 6.00% (0.06) = £12,720.00 (Source: Year 2 opening balance × fixed annual rate)
- Closing Balance (End of Year 2): £212,000.00 + £12,720.00 = £224,720.00 (Source: Year 2 opening balance + capitalised Year 2 interest)

Year 3 (Months 25–36, GBP, Annual Compounding Basis):
- Opening Balance: £224,720.00 (Source: Year 2 Closing Balance)
- Repayments During Year 3: £0.00 (Source: Request input — nothing repaid)
- Interest Accrued (Year 3): £224,720.00 × 6.00% (0.06) = £13,483.20 (Source: Year 3 opening balance × fixed annual rate)
- Closing Balance (End of Year 3): £224,720.00 + £13,483.20 = £238,203.20 (Source: Year 3 opening balance + capitalised Year 3 interest)

3. Summary of Outputs (End of Year 3, GBP, Accrued & Capitalised Basis)
- Total Owed at End of Year 3: £238,203.20 (GBP, end of Year 3, compounded annually)
- Original Principal Component: £200,000.00 (GBP, initial drawdown)
- Total Accrued Interest Component: £238,203.20 − £200,000.00 = £38,203.20 (GBP, cumulative Years 1–3 accrued and unpaid interest)

4. Independent Verification Arithmetic
- Compound Formula Check: £200,000.00 × (1 + 0.06)^3 = £200,000.00 × 1.191016 = £238,203.20 (matches Year 3 Closing Balance exactly).
- Cumulative Interest Sum Check: £12,000.00 (Year 1) + £12,720.00 (Year 2) + £13,483.20 (Year 3) = £38,203.20 (matches Total Owed minus Principal exactly).
- Note for Reviewer: All accrued interest (£38,203.20) remains unpaid and capitalised into the closing balance. If the loan contract specifies a variable rate, calendar-year compounding with pro-rata days, or fees/charges, the schedule must be adjusted accordingly.
